Opened review-ready PR [#13148: perf(ci): parallelize Windows unit builds](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/13148).

It uses one Windows runner with parallel Cargo builds, separate target directories, and two workers per branch. `mise run lint-fix` passed; CI is queued.
could we instead just add the unused check for all clippy runs?

All current Clippy passes already use `-D warnings`, which includes the `unused` lint group. They run on Linux, though, so they cannot catch code that becomes unused only under Windows `cfg` branches.

A cleaner fix is to apply `RUSTFLAGS=-D unused` to the existing `build-windows` compilation and remove the separate unused-code build from `windows-unit`. That preserves the Windows-specific signal while eliminating the duplicate compilation entirely. I’ll update the PR that way.
could windows just enable warnings?

Yes. Setting `RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings` on both Windows jobs is simpler and stronger: the existing Windows build covers the rustls feature configuration, while `windows-unit` covers default-feature tests and workspace members. That removes the dedicated `cargo check` entirely and adds no extra CI work beyond a one-time cache fingerprint change. I’ll revise PR #13148 to that design.
